changes: Arms release-announcement discovery at gateway startup even when the private release queue is created later.
Uses the connected live Discord adapter for verified announcements without standalone bot-token access.
Reconciles crash retries with one deterministic Discord nonce and exact public readback, avoiding duplicate announcements.
Keeps completion and health bound to the exact version, release SHA, and current gateway restart invocation.
known_limitations: Native reconciliation requires permission to read the target public Discord channel history.
A bounded scan that exceeds 10000 post-request messages fails closed for operator reconciliation.
notes.rollback_note: Rollback restores exact v2.3.3 at d211ee88b99c71d0f8221261a0b826a75efb6351; immutable delivery and reconciliation receipts remain audit evidence.
